answer: Proof of Stake provides Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital, creating a frozen glacier of digital assets that cannot be double-spent. Like a lotus blooming from resource depth, security relies on verifiable scarcity rather than pseudonymous identities. An attacker attempting to flood the wharf of the network must acquire a majority of total staked tokens, a cost that grows prohibitively expensive, ensuring honest participation is the only profitable vector for node operation.
